page_title: MAI 1-1 UNI | Mainz v Union Berlin 07/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Jan Siewert has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brajan Gruda (Mainz) replacing Ludovic Ajorque.
90' Substitution. Tom Krauss makes his way off the pitch and Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) comes on as his replacement.
89' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) receives a yellow card.
89' That's a clear yellow card. Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) goes into the book.
85' Anthony Caci (Mainz) will deliver the corner kick.
84' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
82' Substitution. Kevin Volland will be replaced by Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin).
82' Danijel Jumic prepares a substitution. Robin Gosens is replaced by Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
80' Here comes a substitution. Karim Onisiwo is given a rest as he is replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Mainz).
79' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
78' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) struck with a long-range free kick. His attempt flew just wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was lucky there.
78' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) takes a direct free kick.
78' Dangerous play by Anthony Caci (Mainz). Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
76' Here's the change. Andras Schafer leaves the pitch and Alex Kral (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
75' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
74' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) jumps into a tackle and Martin Petersen signals a foul.
73' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
73' Corner kick. Anthony Caci (Mainz) is ready to send the ball into the box.
71' Total attempts – 14:12.
70' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nadiem Amiri.
66' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
65' A cross by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
64' Problems for Danijel Jumic as Kevin Vogt is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) replaces him.
63' Danijel Jumic has decided to substitute Benedict Hollerbach and he is replaced by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
63' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Flag goes up against Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
58' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
57' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
56' Anthony Caci (Mainz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
54' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Frederik Ronnow to dive and make a save.
54' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
52' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
49' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mainz was in an offside position.
47' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
46' Substitution. Silvan Widmer (Mainz) on for Danny da Costa.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+14' The end of the first half.
45+13' 1 - 1 Goal! Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper low inside the middle of the net. 1:1.
45+12' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow.
45+8' 1 - 0 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
45+8' It will be a corner kick for Mainz.
45+7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
45+1' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
45' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
39' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
35' Tom Krauss (Mainz) trips an opposition player and Martin Petersen signals a foul.
34' Anthony Caci (Mainz) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

33' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mainz.
31' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
30' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
28' Anthony Caci (Mainz) finds Danny da Costa with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
26' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) takes the corner.
25' Wow, what an escape. Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
25' Union Berlin get a free kick.
23' One of the players from Mainz times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
21' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
20' The free kick will be taken by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz).
20' Danny da Costa (Mainz) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
18' Danny da Costa (Mainz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Martin Petersen has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
15' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Neat passing move from Union Berlin in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

11' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Frederik Ronnow shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
10' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
10' Mainz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

9' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save. Mainz have a corner.
9' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will take a corner kick.
7' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
7' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Kevin Volland latches onto his pass.
6' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.

4' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Robin Zentner makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
4' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Zentner punches the ball away.
3' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is about to take a corner kick.
2' Nadiem Amiri swings in the free kick towards Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), who powers a header high over the bar from close in.
2' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Mainz will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen was nominated as the referee for this game.
